benchmarks.rank_note: 采用 Surge AI 官网 Chartography 主榜成绩，按得分降序生成名次，同分并列；不混用旧版 Pareto 图或有工具版本的成绩。
benchmarks.rank_note_en: Ranks are derived from the scores on Surge AI’s main Chartography leaderboard, with tied scores sharing a rank. Older Pareto-chart data and tool-assisted results are not mixed in.

benchmarks.canonical_name: GAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants

benchmarks.rank_note: 采用 Overall 主榜的原始名次与 Pass Rate（完全成功率），保留每个模型＋框架的官网默认最佳推理配置；不混用含部分得分的 Score 或其他任务分组。其他推理强度不沿用最佳配置的名次。
benchmarks.rank_note_en: Uses source ranks and strict Pass Rate from the Overall table, retaining each model/harness pair’s default best effort. Partial-credit Score, other task splits and unranked effort levels are not assigned these ranks.

benchmarks.rank_note: BFS · 256K · F1；当前采用 Claude Opus 4.8 系统卡表 8.9.A 的 4 项公开成绩，按得分降序生成名次，不代表全行业排名。
benchmarks.rank_note_en: BFS · 256K · F1. Ranks are derived from the four published results in Claude Opus 4.8 system card Table 8.9.A, not an industry-wide ranking.
